summary.text: Karen Lueders is a Democratic state representative from Addison-4 District who was appointed by Governor Phil Scott in October 2025 and is seeking election to a full term.
Her background includes practicing law, managing a gallery in Bristol, Vermont, and serving on the boards of Addison Housing Works, Addison County Home Health and Hospice, and Habitat for Humanity.

paragraphs.text: Karen Lueders' career experience includes practicing law and managing a gallery in Bristol, Vermont.
She has served on the boards of Addison Housing Works, Addison County Home Health and Hospice, and Habitat for Humanity.
Governor Phil Scott, a Republican, appointed Lueders to the Vermont House of Representatives on October 17, 2025, to fill the Addison-4 seat vacated by Mari Cordes, a Democrat.
She assumed office on October 22, 2025, and her current term ends in January 2027.
Lueders advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026, with 1,246 votes.
